subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Across Cultures · Reading for Pleasure · Review and Reference
lesson: Reading for Pleasure: interview with Rumaitha Al Busaidi / Review and Reference: Theme 2 learning objectives and core words test
outcomes: Read an interview and find its main ideas
Explain why we should preserve Antarctica
Use the Theme 2 core words and the past perfect correctly

tf.s: Rumaitha Al Busaidi travelled to Antarctica.
tf.why: Yes, the interview is about her trip to Antarctica.

tf.s: The text about Rumaitha is a story.
tf.why: It is an interview with questions and answers.

tf.s: Rumaitha wants to preserve the Antarctic environment.
tf.why: Right, she cares about protecting it.

tf.s: 'Homesick' means feeling sad because you miss home.
tf.why: Correct, it is a feeling of missing home.
'Reduce' means make smaller; 'increase' means make larger.

tf.s: 'Cope with' means to deal successfully with a difficult situation.
'Hadn't wasted' is a past perfect form.
tf.why: Well done: had not + past participle.

tf.s: 'By the time he arrived, we had left' means we left after he arrived.
tf.why: We left first; then he arrived.

tf.s: A deadline is the time by which you must finish something.
tf.why: Yes, you must finish work before the deadline.

boxes.q: What do people do on an expedition?
boxes.why: Expeditions are journeys to explore and learn.

boxes.q: Complete: By the time he arrived, we ___ (leave).
boxes.why: The earlier action takes the past perfect.
To reduce is to make less or smaller.

boxes.q: What is the past perfect of 'take'?

boxes.why: Something terrifying makes you very scared.

boxes.q: Which sentence is in the past perfect?
boxes.why: Had + finished is the past perfect.

o: It affects climate and has unique wildlife
boxes.why: Antarctica matters for the whole planet.
An interviewer asks and the person answers.
You cope with a hard situation successfully.

hunt.q: The last time to finish work
A journey to explore or research
The work you do for many years

mcq.q: What kind of text is the reading about Rumaitha Al Busaidi?
mcq.why: The text has questions and her answers.

o: A test that shows which level or class you should join
A test you take after you graduate
A test about places on a map
mcq.why: It helps put students in the right level.

o: Protecting it and keeping it safe
mcq.why: To preserve is to protect something.

mcq.q: Which helping verb do we use to form the past perfect?
Complete: She ___ (not check) her answers, so she made mistakes.
mcq.why: The earlier action uses hadn't + past participle.

mcq.q: Choose the best word: I must finish my essay before the ___.
mcq.why: A deadline is the time limit for work.

o: She learned to cope with the difficult weather.
She coped with a delicious meal.
He copes with his favourite song every day.
They coped with a holiday they enjoyed.

mcq.q: Why is it important to preserve Antarctica?
o: It affects the world's climate and has unique wildlife

mcq.q: 'By the time we arrived, the film had started.' What happened first?
o: Both happened at the same time
mcq.why: The past perfect shows the earlier action.

mcq.q: What quality does Rumaitha show by going on her trip to Antarctica?
mcq.why: Her trip shows courage and care for the environment.
